publisher: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Bureau of Waterworks
title: 水道料金の基本料金を無償とします（令和8年度 夏の4か月間）— the waiver's own guidance page
archive_note: Browser print-to-PDF supplied by the collector. The page's FAQ is an accordion and prints collapsed: the questions are captured and the answers are not, which is stated below rather than passed over.
establishes: The waived months as a table rather than a sentence: for a property read in an even month the 6–7 and 8–9 billing months, for one read in an odd month the 5–6 and 7–8 billing months, with the first waived reading taken on 1 June.
The eligible bores, 13, 20 and 25 mm, marked on the Bureau's own rate table so the waived rows are the rows of the standing tariff.
The four-month value at each bore: 3,440円 (3,784円 with tax), 4,680円 (5,148円), 5,840円 (6,424円).
How a household checks it: on the meter slip the item 水道 and the line 基本料金, which reads 0円 during the waiver.
A specimen meter slip and a specimen app screen, both under the waiver, which are what make this document reconcilable rather than merely descriptive.
does_not_establish: The FAQ answers. Ten questions are visible and every answer is collapsed in the capture, including whether the sewerage charge is waived. That question is answered here by the specimen slip's arithmetic instead, which is stronger than the answer would have been.
The waiver's authority. The press release carries that.
reconciliations_passed: Specimen meter slip, 20 mm, 40 m3 over 61 days, Reiwa 8 months 5–6, water: basic 0円 under the waiver; volumetric 2 × (22 × 5 + 128 × 10) = 2,780円; tax 278円; total 3,058円. The slip prints 3,058. Exact — and it is the payable price reconciled, not the structural one.

The same slip, sewerage: 2 × 560 = 1,120円 basic, 2 × (110 × 12) = 2,640円 volumetric, tax 376円, total 4,136円. The slip prints 4,136. Exact, and it settles the FAQ question the capture cannot answer: the sewerage basic charge is alive on a bill where the water basic charge is zero.

Specimen app screen, 20 mm, 32 m3 over two months: volumetric 2 × (22 × 5 + 128 × 6) = 1,756円, tax 175.6 truncated to 175円, total 1,931円. The screen prints 1,931. Exact, and the truncation rule is visible in a live bill rather than inferred from a formula.
archive_text_note: The text layer of the same PDF, extracted mechanically with pdftotext and not retyped. On the Japanese captures the font's character map is broken and the kanji extract as mojibake; the digits do not, and the digits are what the verbatim second pass reads. The PDF is the capture; this file is the machine-readable face of it.
